discount.description: 12% discount applies to base charges only

overage.text: Overage rate: $0.08 per unit above monthly limit of 5,000 units. Overage charges are calculated at the end of each billing cycle.

base_limit.text: Base usage limit: 5,000 units per month. Units are measured as individual API calls aggregated across all endpoints.

discount_scope.text: Discounts apply to base charges only. Any discount applied to overage charges requires explicit written approval in the executed order form.

termination.text: Either party may terminate with 45 days written notice.

payment.text: Payment due within 30 days of invoice date.

governing_law.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

legal_terms.governing_law: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
legal_terms.termination_notice: Either party may terminate this Agreement with forty-five (45) days prior written notice.
legal_terms.renewal_term: This Agreement renews annually unless either party provides notice prior to renewal.
